# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 to 11 years old  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Yankee  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is small for his age, appearing to be around eight years old when he is ten. He has a tiny face with delicate, exquisitely refined features, crimson lips, and dark blue eyes surrounded by a halo of chestnut brown curls. He dresses elegantly, including a fur cap and coat.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c27 P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)_

## Personality

Cedric is an exceptionally unusual, brilliant, and imaginative child who holds grave, meditative expressions alongside bright, warm smiles. He possesses a strong sense of fairness, gentlemanly manners, and notable manliness that earns him respect despite his romantic fancies. Deeply affectionate, he cares greatly for his family and teacher, though he struggles with bashfulness and small childhood anxieties.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036)_

- Storytelling and rich imagination  <sub>[v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)</sub>

- Wants a mother  <sub>[v2 c28 P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045)</sub>
- Wants to grow as tall as his father  <sub>[v2 c27 P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)</sub>

## History

Cedric Stanhope relocates from Boston to Brierley to reside with his grandmother, Grandma Stanhope, along the shore road. Upon joining Nell Harcourt's school, the two share an instant mutual understanding and form a deep connection. He introduces Nell to his vivid inner world, sharing tales of his imaginary stone companions, such as Nora, as well as fairy tales he devises. While attending school, he develops a sweetheart affection for Gracie Pullen, bringing her flowers and carrying her books. On one occasion, after Gracie giggles when another student accuses his grandmother of curling his hair, Cedric plunges his head into a spring to demonstrate his curls are natural, accidentally falling in completely. He also visits Echo Cottage with Nell, meeting Miss Rosalind Penrose and subsequently writing a letter to his father about her. This letter prompts his father, Stephen Stanhope, to alter his travel plans and visit Brierley, leading to a surprise reunion between father and son.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Boston prior to moving to Brierley  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- Mother passed away, after which he became closer to his father  <sub>[v2 c15 P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009)</sub>
- Moved to Brierley to live with his grandmother near the shore  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- Fought St. Clair Trask over a debate regarding the Union Jack and Stars and Stripes  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
